+        <para>If <option>--tpm2-device=</option> is also declared, the volume is bound to the TPM2 and the

+        FIDO2 token's <literal>hmac-secret</literal> is derived from that secret, so that the token can only
+        be asked for the right answer on a system whose TPM2 policy is satisfied. The answer of the token is
+        the key used for the LUKS2 key slot. Before the salt is sent, the token has to prove possession of
+        the enrolled credential by signing a fresh challenge, so that a FIDO2 token emulator cannot obtain
+        the salt. When the token is enrolled with user verification
+        (<option>--fido2-with-user-verification=yes</option>), this proof requires a separate user
+        verification. <option>--fido2-salt-file=</option> is not supported in this combined mode. At most a
+        single PIN is used for both mechanisms: if both <option>--tpm2-with-pin=</option> and
+        <option>--fido2-with-client-pin=</option> are enabled, the TPM2 PIN is also used as the FIDO2 token's
+        client PIN, hence enter the token's PIN as the TPM2 PIN.</para>
